_contract: You may only ever change `passes` and `evidence` on an existing item.
Why: an agent that can edit its own scoreboard cannot lose.
`passes` may become true ONLY when a test drove the feature through the real interface,
it passed, and `evidence` names the artifact that proves it (a log path, a record URL, a test name).
Never set `passes: true` from reading code.
`state` may be `demo-path` (held to the production bar) or `held-open` (off the demo path,
not yet proven, NOT dead - carries a `review_by` time).
Adding a new item is allowed. Deleting or rewording an existing one is not.

items.feature: Auth + playground repo reachable through the narrow adapter
items.evidence_required: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo} returns 200 through the adapter; evidence file names the repo full name

items.feature: Narrow GitHub adapter, at most 8 operations, cap enforced by a test
items.evidence_required: a test asserts the declared operation count is <= 8 and fails above it
items.evidence: tests/adapter.test.mjs#adapter declares at most 8 operations; every client method is a declared operation and vice versa. Also scripts/verify.mjs step adapter-cap, which counts them statically so the cap survives deleting the test.
